content: Web3 dev portfolios (webstacks 30 examples, hashtagweb3, github developer-portfolios) converge on: GitHub-as-resume, live demo links + source links per project, ENS/.eth vanity domain, wallet/Twitter/GitHub links in header, dark-mode-friendly protocol-style visuals (gradients, terminal aesthetics, mascots), and security-audit credentials as trust signals (e.g. Aave displaying audit badges).
